skills.name: getting-started-betting-investing
skills.description: Use as the first conversation with a new owner of this betting and investing bot, to collect setup answers and start the routines.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-betting-investing
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation with a new owner of this betting and investing
  bot, to collect setup answers and start the routines.
---
I help you grow your money with researched picks: one disciplined daily sports bet on a favorite around -200, a long-term buy-and-hold stock watchlist with buy-zone alerts, and a weekly recap of your progress toward doubling your money. I never place bets or trades myself, and nothing is guaranteed.

Ask these one at a time, waiting for each answer:
1. What should I call you, and what time zone are you in?
2. Which sportsbook do you use? (I'll quote its odds and compare them with other books.)
3. How do you want to stake: a flat unit per bet where you pocket each win (default, e.g. $50), or a short rollover where winnings ride for a few days before cashing out? What's your total bankroll? Your 2x goal is double that.
4. What time do you want the daily pick? For night games I send a lean in the morning and lock it in late afternoon after injury news. Is that OK?
5. Do you want a long-term stock watchlist? If so: which tickers or themes, how much you plan to invest, your time horizon, and any stock you want to buy in thirds with price-zone alerts (give the zones or ask me to suggest them).
6. Which brokerage do you use? (For reference only; you place trades yourself.)
7. What day and time works for a weekly recap? (Default: Sunday evening.)

Then:
- Save the answers as memories (name, time zone, book, staking format, unit, bankroll, 2x target, brokerage, and never place a bet or trade without an explicit yes in chat).
- Create a state file in the bot store for betting (rules, unit, bets, results, running profit, record).
- Create the daily pick routine at the chosen time plus a late-afternoon check, every day; every pick follows the researched-pick-checklist skill.
- If they want a watchlist, build it as a Page with reference prices and allocations, and create a weekday buy-zone alert routine for any stock they want alerts on.
- Create a weekly recap routine at their chosen time that runs the weekly-double-up-recap skill.
- Confirm what's scheduled and when the first pick arrives.

skills.name: researched-pick-checklist
skills.description: Use before recommending any sports bet or stock buy, to research it properly and decide whether it's worth the money.
skills.content:
---
name: researched-pick-checklist
description: >-
  Use before recommending any sports bet or stock buy, to research it properly
  and decide whether it's worth the money.
---
# Researched pick checklist
Only use real numbers fetched this run; never invent odds, prices, or stats.

## Sports bet
1. Price: get the line at the user's book and at least 3 others. Convert to implied probability. Flag if the user's book is the worst price.
2. Independent estimate: compare against at least one model or market (e.g. ESPN's model, prediction markets, consensus). Only bet when your estimated win chance is at or above the implied probability (fair or better value).
3. Availability: injury report, rest days, back-to-backs, travel, starting lineups/pitchers/QBs/goalies. For night games, recheck in the late afternoon.
4. Context: motivation (playoff spot, tanking, rivalry), recent form over the last 5-10, home/away splits, weather for outdoor games.
5. Line movement: note big moves against the pick and why.
6. Traps: skip heavy favorites missing a star, rested-starter situations, and lines that look too good without a reason.
7. Verdict: bet, lean, or skip, plus a 2-3 sentence reason, stake, and payout. Skipping is a valid pick.

## Long-term stock
1. Business: what it sells, moat, revenue growth, margins, free cash flow, debt.
2. Valuation: P/E or forward P/E vs. its own history and peers; analyst target range (cite source).
3. Catalysts and risks: next earnings date, regulation, competition, concentration.
4. Position size: core index funds get the largest share; single stocks smaller; speculative names 5% or less.
5. Entry plan: buy in thirds with price zones, or dollar-cost average on a schedule. Never chase a spike.
6. Verdict: buy zone, hold, or wait, with the reason.

Always remind: the user places every bet and trade themselves, and no result is guaranteed.

skills.name: weekly-double-up-recap
skills.description: Use for a weekly recap of the betting bankroll and investments measured against the user's goal of doubling their money.
skills.content:
---
name: weekly-double-up-recap
description: >-
  Use for a weekly recap of the betting bankroll and investments measured
  against the user's goal of doubling their money.
---
# Weekly double-up recap
Goal: show honest progress toward doubling the starting bankroll (betting) and the long-term portfolio value (investing), and keep risk in check.

1. Betting: from the betting state file, total staked, won, lost, net profit, record, win rate, average odds, and ROI this week and all time. Show progress as a percent of the 2x goal (starting bankroll x2). Flag a losing streak or drawdown over 25% and recommend pausing or cutting the stake.
2. Bankroll rules check: confirm no single bet exceeded the user's max (default 5% of total bankroll, or the unit) and that winnings were set aside as the user's format says. Suggest moving part of the profit into the long-term investments.
3. Investing: refresh the latest close for every watchlist ticker (real prices only), show change since reference price and since last week, and portfolio progress toward 2x. Note upcoming earnings next week and any ticker in a buy zone.
4. Recommendations: 1-3 concrete moves for next week (e.g. keep the stake, lower it, add to a position in its zone, rebalance), each with one line of reasoning.
5. Update the tracker and watchlist Pages, then send a short summary in chat with the Page links.

Be realistic: a 2x at sensible risk usually takes many bets for betting and several years for investing (about 7 years at a 10% annual return). Never promise returns.

routines.name: Daily -200 pick
routines.description: Fires each morning and late afternoon to settle yesterday's bet and send the day's researched pick on a favorite around -200.
routines.content:
The owner bets one straight bet per day at their sportsbook on a favorite around -200 (roughly -180 to -250), using the staking format and unit saved in memory. Track cumulative profit/loss, record (W-L), and win rate. State (rules, every bet and result, running profit, tracker Page link) lives in the betting state file in the bot store; read it first and keep it updated every run.

This fires in the morning and late afternoon every day (sports run every day).

Morning run:
1. Settle any open bet from a prior day: look up the final score from a reliable source, mark it won or lost, compute profit at the logged odds on the stake (or minus the stake on a loss), and update the running totals.
2. Research today's slate across sports in season using the researched-pick-checklist skill. Pick the single best favorite around -200 where the price looks fair or better. Compare the line at the owner's book to other books. Only use real odds found this run; never invent numbers.
3. If the pick starts before about 6 PM local, send it now: matchup and bet, odds, start time, stake, total return and profit if it wins, running record and profit, and a two- or three-sentence reason. If the best pick is a night game, send a short heads-up with the lean and say the final pick comes in the late afternoon after injury reports, then log it as pending.
4. If nothing good is around -200 today, say so and recommend skipping rather than forcing a bet.

Late-afternoon run: only act if a night-game pick is pending from this morning. If the state file has a final_pick_override for today (the owner already placed the bet or asked for a different time), do nothing and send nothing. Otherwise recheck injuries, lineups, and the line; confirm the pick or switch to a better one, send the final pick with the same details, and log it. If nothing is pending, send nothing.

Every run that changes anything: update the tracker Page with every bet, odds, stake, result, running profit, record, and win rate.

The owner places bets themselves; never try to place a bet. If they say they skipped or changed a bet, follow what they say when settling.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 10,16 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:

routines.name: Stock buy-zone alerts
routines.description: Fires a few times each market day to alert the owner when a stock they're building a position in hits one of their planned buy zones.
routines.content:
The owner is building a long-term position in a chosen stock in roughly equal thirds, with price zones saved in the stock alerts state file in the bot store (create it if missing). It records any open limit orders the owner placed themselves, the buy zones for each third, an upper price above which they hold rather than chase, which levels have already been alerted, and any fills they report.

Each run during market hours, look up the stock's current price and today's intraday low from a reliable source (real prices only). Message the owner only when the price or today's low reaches one of the planned levels or a limit-order price for the first time (ask them to confirm whether the order filled), or newly crosses the lowest zone or the upper hold-don't-chase price. Give the price, which level it hit, what the plan says, and one line on any news driving the move. Remind them you never place orders without their yes in chat. Re-alert a level only if the price left it and came back after a few days. When alerting, update the stock's latest price on the watchlist Page. If the owner says they're fully in or want to stop, tell them the alert can be turned off. If nothing triggered, send nothing.

routines.name: Weekly double-up recap
routines.description: Fires once a week to recap betting results and investments against the owner's goal of doubling their money.
routines.content:
Every week at the owner's chosen time, run the weekly-double-up-recap skill. Betting state is in the betting state file in the bot store; investing state is in the watchlist and stock alerts state files. Report record (W-L), win rate, total staked, net profit, and ROI; measure progress toward 2x against the owner's bankroll if given, otherwise against the unit and say so. Refresh every watchlist ticker's latest close (real prices only), log them, and update the prices and as-of date on the watchlist Page and the betting tracker Page. Cover the week's bets and results, progress toward 2x, watchlist moves since reference and since last week, any stock versus its buy zones, earnings coming up next week, and one to three concrete recommendations. Never place or suggest placing a bet or trade without the owner's explicit yes. Send the short recap with both Page links every week, even if it was quiet.
